subject: Aurora Health — Privacy & Security follow-up: pen test report and vuln process
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@aurorahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Health — Privacy & Security follow-up: pen test report and vuln process

Hi Amy / Samir —

Great to meet with you earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the asks we agreed to capture: 

- Aurora asked for current SOC 2 posture (Type II timeline), HIPAA / PHI handling details, and confirmation on GDPR responsibilities.
- You requested a copy of our most recent external pen test report and an overview of our vulnerability management process (SLAs, scanning cadence, disclosure).
- You also want to kick off Aurora's vendor security questionnaire — I attached a draft we can start from.

Next steps we proposed on the call:
1) Aurora to confirm preferred timeline and any mandatory audit windows.
2) Redwood to share the pen test report (redacted as needed), our internal vuln SLA, and a recommended scanning cadence.
3) If helpful, we can draft a short mutual action plan and schedule a technical kickoff with our infra lead.

I've attached the vendor-questionnaire-Aurora.xlsx (draft) for your initial review. If you can flag any must-have questions, I'll escalate internally.

Thanks — looking forward to the next steps.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
E: rachel.kim@redwood.ai | M: +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: vendor-questionnaire-Aurora.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 28KB)
From: Amy Chen <amy.chen@aurorahealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorahealth.com>, vendor.security@aurorahealth.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 22:15:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Privacy & Security follow-up: pen test report and vuln process

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the summary and the questionnaire. A few quick items from our side: 

- SOC 2: we're currently SOC 2 Type II certified for our core patient data platform; Aurora Health is targeting vendor SOC 2 Type II evidence for all partners by the end of Q4 2026. Can you confirm Redwood's SOC status and expected timeline if there are upgrades planned?
- HIPAA / PHI: We will require a BAA for any service that processes PHI. Please confirm whether Redwood has an existing BAA template and whether you've signed BAAs for other health customers.
- Data residency & GDPR: Aurora has patients in the EU; we need clarification on how data residency and subject access requests are handled if we send PII/PHI through Redwood.

On pen testing and vuln management specifically, please provide:
1) Redacted external pen test report (most recent), or a summary of findings and remediation status.
2) Your vulnerability SLAs (acknowledgement SLAs, triage, remediation windows by severity).
3) Scanning cadence (internal continuous, external quarterly/annual, ad-hoc after major releases).
4) Responsible disclosure policy and contact for security researchers.

I've attached our Aurora_Security_Intake_Form.pdf to capture the vendor-specific items. If you can send your pen test doc and a proposed SLA/cadence, we'll route through procurement and InfoSec.

Thanks,
Amy Chen
Security & Risk Manager | Aurora Health
amy.chen@aurorahealth.com | +1 212-555-0199

Attachment: Aurora_Security_Intake_Form.pdf (PDF, 92KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Aurora request — pen report + vuln process (quick alignment)

Looping you in after Aurora's intake form. High-level suggested responses and internal asks: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently SOC 2 Type I (control environment) with Type II target in the roadmap for H1 2027. We should confirm language (we can provide Type I report now and timeline summary).
- BAA: We have a BAA template; legal will need to review any redlines.
- Pen test: we can share a redacted pen test report from 2025. Recommend we produce a one-page executive summary + redactions for customer-sensitive items.
- Vulnerability management (proposal):
  * Acknowledgement SLA: within 48 hours business
  * Triage & classification: 5 business days
  * Remediation target: Critical — 14 calendar days after confirmed reproduction; High — 30 calendar days; Medium/Low — next maintenance window (quarterly).
  * Scanning cadence: external full pentest annually; external infra scan quarterly (depending on scope); internal authenticated scans monthly; continuous monitoring for runtime anomalies.
  * Disclosure: 72-hour initial notification to customer for critical findings; public disclosure only after coordinated remediation or 90 days if unresolved.

Action items for us: Grace — can you draft the redacted pen-test exec summary and confirm whether 14-day critical SLA is realistic? Dev — please confirm the recommended scanning cadence and whether we can commit to monthly authenticated scans for Aurora's expected scope.

-Marcus
Director, Customer Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Chen <amy.chen@aurorahealth.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Aug 2026 09:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora Health — Privacy & Security follow-up: pen test report and vuln process

Hi Amy / Samir —

Thanks for the questions and for sending the intake form. We attached Redwood's proposed pen-test oversight package (redwood-pen-test-oversight-request.pdf) and an updated copy of the vendor questionnaire with a couple of Aurora-specific notes filled in.

To be explicit on the items you asked about: 
- SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type I today. Type II is on our roadmap (expected program milestone H1 2027); we'll include a short timeline in the materials we send.
- BAA: We have a standard BAA template — legal is ready to review and we can include it in the next package.
- Pen test report: Attached is a redacted executive summary of our most recent external test (we will not publish full test details publicly). We propose sharing the redacted report under an NDA; if Aurora needs deeper detail we can arrange a redacted session with our security lead.
- Vulnerability SLAs & cadence (proposed): Acknowledge 48 hrs; triage 5 business days; remediation windows as Marcus outlined (Critical 14 days, High 30 days). Scanning cadence: authenticated internal monthly, external vulnerability scans quarterly, full external pentest annually or after major platform changes. Responsible disclosure: contact vendor.security@redwood.ai; we provide an initial notification to customers within 72 hours for critical issues and coordinate remediation.

Suggested next steps:
1) Please confirm NDA/BAA preference so we can share the redacted report.
2) If you approve the proposed SLAs and cadence, I'll send the final vendor questionnaire + our pen-test exec summary and a HubSpot link to track the mutual action plan: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/12345
3) Schedule a technical kickoff (30–45m) next week with our infra lead (Dev) and Grace from security. What times work for your InfoSec team?

Thanks — attaching the files here.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-pen-test-oversight-request.pdf (PDF, 64KB); vendor-questionnaire-Aurora.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, updated, 32KB)
